ui.title: mouseTube database schema
ui.sub: Tables of mousetube_api/models.py, with every field described in its card. {count} Touch or hover a table to isolate its links.
ui.fk: foreign key (dot: the “many” side, triangle: the table it points to)
ui.note: Every entry also has a created_by pointing to User: these links are not drawn, to keep the schema readable. The greyed rows of each card are the fields that point to another table. The moderation statuses follow the same cycle everywhere: draft, waiting validation, validated (a session adds shared and published). What each role may do according to the status is described in the “Rights and statuses” page.

tables.note: Login account. Standard Django model, defined outside models.py.
fields: E-mail address, confirmed by a link before the account is activated.
First and last name. May be pre-filled from ORCID.
Account is active. False until the e-mail is confirmed and an administrator has accepted the request.
Administrator: access to the Review page and to the admin. Cannot be changed through the API.
Last sign-in. An account that already signed in cannot be rejected from Review.

tables.note: Further information about an account.
fields: Account that owns the profile (one profile per account). Deleted with it (CASCADE).
Laboratory of the person. CASCADE: deleting the laboratory deletes the profile.
ORCID identifier. Linked by a signed proof, never typed freely.
Administrator flag kept on the profile.
User who created the profile (SET NULL).
Preferred display of the lists: cards or table.
Shows the e-mail next to the recordings of the person. False by default.
Sign-ins made up to this moment are no longer valid (log out of all devices, change of password).
E-mail when an administrator validates, or sends back, what the user submitted.
E-mail when the publication of a session on the repository is done or fails.

tables.note: Laboratory or research unit.
fields: Organization in the ROR registry (SET NULL).
Moderation step: draft, waiting validation, validated. Other users are only offered the validated entries.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Person to contact about a piece of software. The e-mails of the contacts are never exported.
fields: Moderation step: draft, waiting validation, validated. Other users are only offered the validated entries.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: A user's favorite, pointing to any permitted entry.
fields: Type of the entry pointed to (Django table). Allowed: protocol, hardware, software, animalprofile, strain, laboratory, reference, contact.
Identifier of the entry pointed to.
Link to the entry pointed to, computed from the two previous fields.

tables.note: Ontology term or ROR organization, checked at its source. Entries point to it next to their free text.
fields: Address of the term in the ontology.

tables.note: Animal species.
fields: NCBI Taxonomy term of the species (SET NULL).
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Animal strain.
fields: EFO term (or RS for the rat) of the strain (SET NULL).
Moderation step: draft, waiting validation, validated. Other users are only offered the validated entries.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Typical profile of the animals used in a recording.
fields: Made from the fields of the profile, never typed: the main ones, then the start of the fingerprint.
Age class: pup, juvenile or adult (default adult).
PATO term of the sex (SET NULL).
MmusDv developmental stage, when the age class is too vague.
ChEBI term of the compound of the treatment.
EFO term of the diet (SET NULL).
Moderation step: draft, waiting validation, validated. Other users are only offered the validated entries.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).
Hash of every field of the profile. The same fields give the same profile: a validated profile is reused, never copied.

tables.note: An individual animal.
fields: Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Reference: article, tutorial or website.
fields: Moderation step: draft, waiting validation, validated. Other users are only offered the validated entries.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Acquisition software, analysis software, or both.
fields: acquisition, analysis or acquisition and analysis. Only the two « acquisition » types are used to record.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: A precise version of a software. Deleting the last version deletes the software.
Acquisition or playback equipment.
fields: Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Experimental protocol. Its name is computed when it is saved.
fields: Generated from the fields below, cannot be changed. Example: 2MAG_S_HCBD (2 animals, males, adults, grouped, short term, home cage, bedding, day).
male(s), female(s), male(s) & female(s) or unspecified.
grouped, isolated, grouped & isolated or unspecified.
short term (<1h), mid term (<1day), long term (>=1day) or unspecified.
unfamiliar test cage, familiar test cage, home cage or unspecified.
Forced to validated at every save: a protocol is a code, not an entry to moderate.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Study or research project. Private to its author: nobody else lists or picks it, and an administrator never reviews it.
fields: Stays draft: a study is not moderated. Its name still shows on a shared session.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: A recording session: the centre of the schema. It gathers the protocol, the animals, the equipment and the files, and it is what gets published.
fields: Name of the session, unique per author.
Multiple session, without a precise start date.
Protocol followed (SET NULL). Required to publish.
Start date. Required when the session is not multiple.
Behaviors recorded, as terms of the Neuro Behavior Ontology.
draft, waiting validation (waiting for review), shared (public) or published (public and deposited with a DOI).
Global DOI of the record: the same for all its versions.
Published record: synced (up to date), pending (update running), blocked (waits for the validation of new entries) or failed.
Readable explanation of the state, for example the cause of a failure.
Publication after validation: approved (preview approved), publishing, done, stale (what would be published changed) or failed. Empty without a request.
Readable explanation of the state: cause of a failure, or of the preview that became obsolete.
Repository the author chose for the automatic publication (SET NULL). Never shown to the public.
Metadata the author approved. Never shown to the page; erased once published.
Fingerprint of what would have been published when it was approved: used to see whether it changed.
Laboratory where the session took place (SET NULL).
Profiles of the animals of the session.
Versions of the acquisition software used.
Number of microphones: mono, stereo or more than 2.
Sound isolation: soundproof room, soundproof cage or no specific sound isolation.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).
tables.cons: Unique: (name, created_by). Every save runs a full validation (type of the equipment, date, protocol before publication).

tables.note: A file of a session: audio recording, video or table, deposited in a repository or simply linked.
fields: WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, AIFF, AVI, MP4, MOV, MKV, CSV, TXT, XLSX, XLS, ZIP, JPEG, PNG, PDF or JSON.
Image of the spectrogram, set by an administrator.
Image of the curve, set by an administrator (useful for datasets).
Sends the spectrogram and the curve to the repository with the record.
Number of vocalizations in the file.
The link answers. Updated by the check of the links.
Number of downloads (once per visitor, file and hour).
Repository where the file is stored (SET NULL).
Identifier of the file at the repository (Zenodo, Figshare…).
Public address of the file at the repository.
Processing: pending, processing, done or error.
Background task that processes the file.
Cause of the failure, in readable words (when status is error).
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Calls found by a detection tool in a file, as the authors exported them.
fields: Tool: usvseg, deepsqueak, avisoft, sonotrack, ratrec or usvtoolbox.
Version of the tool, if known.
DOI of the publication of the tool.
List of the calls: start, end, duration, frequencies and original variables (native).
Summary figures: number of calls, rate, median duration, frequencies.
Sends the author's table to the repository with the record. False by default.
Original table, kept only when it has to be sent.
tables.cons: Unique: (file, tool). A new upload of the same tool replaces the result.

tables.note: A version of the record of a session at the repository. Each version has its own DOI.
fields: Identifier of the deposit or of the record at the repository.

tables.note: External or internal data repository (Zenodo by default).
fields: Name of the repository. The default repository is the one called Zenodo.
Country or region of the repository.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: A set of sessions gathered with their metadata. Created and changed by administrators.
fields: Sessions of the dataset. The drafts of others stay private.
Creation and last modification dates, filled in automatically.
Author of the entry. Stays empty if their account is deleted (SET NULL).

tables.note: Page-view counter per page and per day. No relation.
fields: Path of the page, without parameters. Pages with a secret (activation, password) are masked.
